description:
Record a decision on a provider version review

Approves or rejects a provider version awaiting review. Admin only. Approval promotes the version to the live channel; rejection moves it to the rejected branch with a reason. Use admin_reviews to find versions waiting on a decision.

body.description: Body for recording a decision on a provider version in `in_review`. On `APPROVED` the branch tag is cleared and the version is promoted to the live channel (becomes public). On `REJECTED` the branch becomes `rejected`.

notes.description: Free-form rationale shown to the author.

name: decide_provider_version_review
